title: Technology-enhanced learning in nursing education: a systematic review.
summary: Technology-enhanced learning (TEL), including artificial intelligence (AI), virtual reality (VR), high-fidelity simulation (HFS), and gamification, is increasingly used in nursing education to address limitations in clinical training and support the development of students' clinical reasoning skills...
